title: Pure Starry Knight
summary: Starry Knight cards with the Level 7 LIGHT Dragons they summon, plus generic Rank 4s, Rank 7s, Links and staples. The Starry Knights are LIGHT Fairies that bounce Level 7 LIGHT Dragons to the hand and summon them again on either turn. Starry Night, Starry Dragon is their partner and destroys a card each time it is summoned from the hand. Starry Knight Rayel searches a Starry Knight Spell/Trap, and Starry Knight Balefire searches a Starry Knight or a Level 7 LIGHT Dragon. Starry Knight Sky grants an extra Normal Summon and draws when a Dragon returns to the hand. Starry Knight Astel and Orbitael tribute a LIGHT monster on either turn to summon a Dragon or Set a Starry Knight Trap. Starry Knight Blast returns a Dragon to the hand to negate an effect. Starring Knight, the newest card, is a Rank 4 that summons a LIGHT monster from the hand.

allow.Starry Night, Starry Dragon: The Level 7 LIGHT Dragon the Starry Knight cards summon and return to the hand.
